sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Keeps a map centered on one moving thing, such as the selected track, while it is drawn: each new position is eased to and the camera is held, and a banner in a corner says what is followed, with a button that lets it go. Dragging the map lets it go too.

anatomy.banner: A chip in its corner, the top left by default: card at 95 percent, padded 8 before and 2 after, 2 down, rounded by radius-control, with the surface's elevation and a 1 ring in map-selection; a crosshair icon 14 square in map-selection, then words.following with the name in text.xs at 500, cut with an ellipsis, then an icon button (words.release, a cross) control-xs square, 6 apart.

position.does: Where the followed thing is now: longitude, latitude.

name.does: What is followed, as the banner names it.

onRelease.does: Called when the reader lets it go, by the button or by dragging the map.

zoom.does: The zoom it goes to when it starts, unless the map is in closer already.

duration.does: How long each step after the followed thing takes, easing out, as a track layer's transition does.

sokkel-ui: It holds the camera through the map's context (holdCamera), so the map stops fitting its layers while it follows.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
